svg.title: This follows by conjugating translations and comparing characteristic functions, using preservation of Hilbert inner products. If p is in the support of μv, then r∨p is in the support of the right side of (SP1), and hence has nonnegative time component for every r. The characterization just proved makes p future causal. Thus every diagonal measure is supported in the closed forward cone, and polarization gives P(V c +) = 0. (SP2)
